## Session R406 (plan #406 t6-rerun)

  run started. It holds every host fix of plan #406: `d6d93303` (a vertex shader reading two textures,

  with `tools/mali/panthor-gles/build.sh` (release, `report-es2`). The build is within the GLIBC 2.41 /
  GLIBCXX 3.4.33 / CXXABI 1.3.15 floors (needs at most 2.38 / 3.4.32 / 1.3.9).

- **Command:** `HOLD_MAX=28800 tools/cts/mali-deqp-run.sh --build <build-dir> --out
  tools/cts/log/2026-11-26-t6-gles2-R406-c8fbf34e --rows 1-18 --tree build/r406/tree.txt --session adhoc
